pipeline: CPU MuJoCo 3.8.1 physics with offline CPU Blender Cycles PBR
accepted_visual_repairs: Preserve helper and clothing masks, authored UVs and full-face garment grouping across 45 human variants.
Preserve authored corner normals; smooth hand/cat normals across UV seams without moving their vertices.
Cover the hand wrist cut with a fitted cloth cuff; preserve original 2048px hand diffuse pixels across all six variants without upsampling.
Restore compatible source normal/roughness/metallic maps, including original cloth normal maps, with UV checks.
Constrain cat carpet segmentation to remove the scanned support plane while retaining anatomy.
Use physical texture scale on MuJoCo planes and preserve label UV orientation and exact task cameras.
Keep flower-pot shell dimensions separate from the plant bounding box and preserve its saucer/soil/leaves.
Apply sofa recoloring separately to fabric and leather while preserving the wooden frame.
Restore source spectacle lens geometry and render declared glass and clear water films with full transmission.
Drive display emission from its authored color/texture to retain text contrast.
Keep caller paper-box colors with neutral fibre maps and separate all original carton tape strips from paper.
Align only the standing dog's visual heading with its original +x head site; keep the lying variant and all OBJ/UV/texture files unchanged.

rejected_experiments.reason: Three isolated bounded skeletal-fit trials improved torso/head support but still penetrated the support plane. Final trial minimums: side upper arm -21.4mm; prone thigh -17.3mm. Rejected against the -5mm threshold; accepted packs were not replaced.
Experimental sphinx pose had incorrect height and paw fit; not promoted.
A tenfold reduction gave negligible improvement in the paired test; not promoted.

Removing the transparent surface bevel did not remove the radial floor-refraction artifact in a controlled paired render. Source cap normals are planar and continuous; no ineffective change was promoted.

limits: Skin remains waxy in some views; source skins provide diffuse maps without measured micro-normal or roughness maps.
Fallen human support contacts, lying dog anatomy, clothing fit and some scan seams still need replacement assets or more fitting work.
Many furniture, towels, plants and food shapes retain simplified geometry; PBR does not replace missing geometry.
Thin transmitting surfaces pass direct shadow rays straight through; focused refractive caustics are not simulated.
The beaker retains a radial bottom-refraction artifact. The dog retains scan seams, and the original collar colour is not represented by its scan.
All images are offline initial-state snapshots; agent observations, online renderer latency and complete task admission were not changed or validated.
Physical-array and 50-step replay checks do not establish full episode equivalence or visual/physical semantic alignment on their own.
The default cat scan's highest surface is about 7.8cm below the original primitive head-top site despite correct heading. Body-region fit needs a separate check before formal benchmark admission.
Source/license declarations are inherited from the local pilot; this is not a new upstream rights audit.
